config.pair_rule: both absent or both present; evidence contains 1..64 entries
config.attestation_dir_control_set: reject U+0000..U+001F and U+007F; backslash is a literal POSIX filename character
config.r0_rule: an R0-only judge table is legal only for the attestation pair

safe_io.missing: ENOENT at any path component returns None
safe_io.unsafe: symlink, non-directory parent, non-regular final object, permission failure, or limit overflow raises ERROR/UNREADABLE_ARTIFACT

git.literal_pathspec_owner: the existing _run_bytes global --literal-pathspecs option remains mandatory; attestation helpers do not bypass the generic boundary
git.abnormal_group_cleanup: deadline, stdout/stderr overflow, pump failure, and caller exception terminate the owned process group; deadline re-raises its original exception

attestation.load_call: load_attested_evidence(repo, head=head, declared=declared, project_root=project_root, attestation_dir=attestation_dir, remaining=remaining)
attestation.public_boundary_validation: repeat directory/source/key/duplicate grammar and fail BAD_LANE_CONFIG before safe I/O
attestation.json_member_rule: duplicate member names and strings that cannot be encoded as UTF-8 are unreadable
attestation.deadline_sampling: at batch entry, after every bounded read/parse, before every Git wait through its helper, and immediately before return including all-missing batches

runner.source_of_truth: derive exact ordered declarations from lane.judge.evidence
runner.default_rule: run_lane/refuse_lane reject mismatch before Git, plan, adapter, or command work; assemble_verdict repeats the binding at the final public sink; empty defaults are legal only when the derived lane declaration is empty

lifecycle: load lane and reserve verdict destination
resolve HEAD through git with LaneDeadline.remaining
read all declared attestation files and preflight every structural and aggregate bound
resolve attestation Git facts in declaration order with the same LaneDeadline.remaining
run direct R0 or committed-snapshot rigor with the same LaneDeadline
assemble exactly covering computed claims and sibling evidence
